In the ACTIV-3/TICO Study Group 2022 (Phase 3), for inpatients with COVID-19, the all-cause mortality was 15 events out of 176 in the experimental group (Amubarvimab + Romlusevimab) compared to 13 events out of 178 in the control group (placebo). 2. In the same study, 148 out of 176 patients in the experimental group were discharged, compared to 142 out of 178 in the control group. 3. Clinical recovery was observed in 155 out of 176 patients in the experimental group, compared to 151 out of 178 in the control group. 4. Mechanical ventilation was required in 4 out of 176 patients in the experimental group, compared to 3 out of 178 in the control group. 5. In the Chen 2021 (BLAZE-1, Phase 2) study, for outpatients with COVID-19, there were no events of all-cause mortality in either the experimental or control groups. 6. In the Lundgren 2022 (ACTIV, Phase 3) study, for inpatients with COVID-19, mechanical ventilation was required in 8 out of 161 patients in the experimental group, compared to 5 out of 150 in the control group. 7. In the Chew 2021 (ACTIV, Phase 2) study, the mean time to clinical recovery for outpatients with COVID-19 was 23.09 days (SD 12.08) in the experimental group, compared to 19.92 days (SD 14.42) in the control group. 8. In the Gottlieb 2021 (BLAZE-1, Phase 2) study, clinical recovery was observed in 210 out of 262 patients in the experimental group, compared to 96 out of 129 in the control group. 9. In the Dougan 2021 (BLAZE-1, Phase 3, low dose) study, the mean time to clinical recovery for outpatients with COVID-19 was 8 days (SD 11.53) in the experimental group, compared to 10 days (SD 12.29) in the control group. 10. In the Recovery Collaborative Group 2022 study, for inpatients with COVID-19, all-cause mortality occurred in 943 out of 4839 patients in the experimental group (Casirivimab + Imdevimab), compared to 1029 out of 4946 in the control group. 11. In the same study, the mean duration of hospitalization for inpatients with COVID-19 was 10 days (SD 16.3) in the experimental group, compared to 10 days (SD 17.04) in the control group. 12. In the Dong 2022 (China, Phase 2/3) study, for inpatients with COVID-19, all-cause mortality occurred in 1 out of 99 patients in the experimental group (Etesevimab), compared to 0 out of 98 in the control group. 13. In the Streinu-Cercel 2022 (Celltrion, Phase 2/3) study, for outpatients with COVID-19, clinical recovery was observed in 186 out of 203 patients in the experimental group (Regdanvimab), compared to 99 out of 104 in the control group. 14. In the Gupta 2022 (COMET-ICE, Phase 3) study, for outpatients with COVID-19, all-cause mortality occurred in 0 out of 528 patients in the experimental group (Sotrovimab), compared to 2 out of 529 in the control group. 15. In the Montgomery 2022 (TACKLE, Phase 2/3) study, for outpatients with COVID-19, all-cause mortality occurred in 6 out of 452 patients in the experimental group (Tixagevimab + Cilgavimab), compared to 6 out of 451 in the control group. 16. In the same study, serious adverse events were reported in 33 out of 452 patients in the experimental group, compared to 54 out of 451 in the control group.
